title: Fix resolve-tasks.mjs task-id branch lookup ordering
description:
scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs:314-316 mTask branch fires before mJira and looks up all.find(x => x.id === mTask[1]). For input 'task-005', capture is '005' but real shard ids are 'TASK-005' (uppercase prefixed). Lookup misses, returns resolution:'none'. For input 'TASK-005', the /i flag makes mTask match too (capture='005'), so JIRA branch is unreachable for any 'task-...' or 'TASK-...' input.

Workaround: pass 'task-TASK-005' so capture='TASK-005'.

Fix options (pick one):
  1. Reorder: check mJira BEFORE mTask (cleanest; preserves mTask for legacy lowercase 'task-42' numeric ids).
  2. In mTask branch: when capture is bare digits, retry with primary library's id prefix (read from sample shard or schema).
  3. Fallthrough: if mTask lookup misses, retry as JIRA pattern on full target.

Recommended: option 1 (reorder). Trivial diff. Acceptance: `node scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs TASK-005` returns queue with 1 task in any project where TASK-005 exists.
acceptance_criteria: node scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs TASK-005 in issues-plugin returns resolution:task-id with TASK-005 in queue
node scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs task-005 in issues-plugin returns same result
node scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs sprint-5 still returns all 8 sprint-5 tasks (regression check)
node scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs count:5 still returns first 5 tasks (regression check)
